verses.original: Τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἐν Ἐφέσῳ γράψον Τάδε λέγει ὁ κρατῶν τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἀστέρας ἐν αὐτοῦ τῇ δεξιᾷ ὁ περιπατῶν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἑπτὰ τῶν χρυσῶν λυχνιῶν
verses.transliteration: Tō angelō tēs ekklēsias en Ephesō grapson Tade legei ho kratōn tous hepta asteras en autou tē dexia ho peripatōn en mesō tōn hepta tōn chrysōn lychniōn
verses.literal: To the angel of the church in Ephesus write These [are] the words of Him who holds the seven stars in His - right hand - [and] walks vvv among the seven - golden lampstands

verses.original: Οἶδα σου τὰ ἔργα καὶ σου τὸν κόπον καὶ τὴν ὑπομονήν καὶ ὅτι οὐ δύνῃ βαστάσαι κακούς καὶ ἐπείρασας καὶ εὗρες αὐτοὺς ψευδεῖς τοὺς καὶ εἰσίν οὐκ λέγοντας ἑαυτοὺς ἀποστόλους
verses.transliteration: Oida sou ta erga kai sou ton kopon kai tēn hypomonēn kai hoti ou dynē bastasai kakous kai epeirasas kai heures autous pseudeis tous kai eisin ouk legontas heautous apostolous
verses.literal: I know your - deeds - your - labor and [your] perseverance [I know] that vvv you cannot tolerate [those who are] evil and you have tested and exposed - as liars those who vvv vvv falsely claim to be apostles

verses.original: καὶ οὐ κεκοπίακες καὶ ἔχεις ὑπομονὴν καὶ ἐβάστασας διὰ μου τὸ ὄνομά
verses.transliteration: kai ou kekopiakes kai echeis hypomonēn kai ebastasas dia mou to onoma
verses.literal: Without . . . growing weary - you have persevered and endured many things for the sake of My - name

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ ἔχω ὅτι κατὰ σοῦ ἀφῆκες σου τὴν πρώτην τὴν ἀγάπην
verses.transliteration: Alla echō hoti kata sou aphēkes sou tēn prōtēn tēn agapēn
verses.literal: But I have this against you You have abandoned your - first - love

verses.original: οὖν μνημόνευε πόθεν πέπτωκας καὶ μετανόησον καὶ ποίησον τὰ ἔργα πρῶτα δὲ εἰ μή ἐὰν μὴ μετανοήσῃς ἔρχομαί σοι καὶ κινήσω σου τὴν λυχνίαν ἐκ αὐτῆς τοῦ τόπου
verses.transliteration: oun mnēmoneue pothen peptōkas kai metanoēson kai poiēson ta erga prōta de ei mē ean mē metanoēsēs erchomai soi kai kinēsō sou tēn lychnian ek autēs tou topou
verses.literal: Therefore keep in mind how far you have fallen - Repent and perform the deeds [you did] at first But if vvv vvv vvv you do not repent I will come to you and remove your - lampstand from its - place

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ ἔχεις τοῦτο ὅτι μισεῖς τὰ ἔργα τῶν Νικολαϊτῶν ἃ κἀγὼ μισῶ
verses.transliteration: Alla echeis touto hoti miseis ta erga tōn Nikolaitōn ha kagō misō
verses.literal: But you have this [to your credit] You hate the works of the Nicolaitans which I also hate

verses.original: Ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ Πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις Τῷ νικῶντι δώσω αὐτῷ φαγεῖν ἐκ τοῦ ξύλου τῆς ζωῆς ὅ ἐστιν ἐν τῷ Παραδείσῳ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ho echōn ous akousatō ti to Pneuma legei tais ekklēsiais Tō nikōnti dōsō autō phagein ek tou xylou tēs zōēs ho estin en tō Paradeisō tou Theou
verses.literal: He who has an ear let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches To the [one who] overcomes I will grant [the right] . . . to eat from the tree - of life - - in the Paradise - of God

verses.original: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἐν Σμύρνῃ γράψον Τάδε λέγει ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος ὃς ἐγένετο νεκρὸς καὶ ἔζησεν
verses.transliteration: Kai tō angelō tēs ekklēsias en Smyrnē grapson Tade legei ho prōtos kai ho eschatos hos egeneto nekros kai ezēsen
verses.literal: - To the angel of the church in Smyrna write These [are] the words of the First and the Last who died . . . and returned to life

verses.original: Οἶδά σου τὴν θλῖψιν καὶ τὴν πτωχείαν ἀλλὰ εἶ πλούσιος καὶ τὴν βλασφημίαν ἐκ τῶν καὶ εἰσίν ἑαυτούς οὐκ λεγόντων εἶναι Ἰουδαίους ἀλλὰ συναγωγὴ τοῦ Σατανᾶ
verses.transliteration: Oida sou tēn thlipsin kai tēn ptōcheian alla ei plousios kai tēn blasphēmian ek tōn kai eisin heautous ouk legontōn einai Ioudaious alla synagōgē tou Satana
verses.literal: I know your - affliction and [your] poverty though you are rich And [I am aware of] the slander of those who - - - falsely claim to be Jews but [are in fact] a synagogue - of Satan

verses.original: Μηδὲν φοβοῦ ἃ μέλλεις πάσχειν ἰδοὺ ὁ διάβολος μέλλει βάλλειν ἐξ ὑμῶν εἰς φυλακὴν ἵνα πειρασθῆτε καὶ ἕξετε θλῖψιν δέκα ἡμερῶν γίνου πιστὸς ἄχρι θανάτου καὶ δώσω σοι τὸν στέφανον τῆς ζωῆς
verses.transliteration: Mēden phobou ha melleis paschein idou ho diabolos mellei ballein ex hymōn eis phylakēn hina peirasthēte kai hexete thlipsin deka hēmerōn ginou pistos achri thanatou kai dōsō soi ton stephanon tēs zōēs
verses.literal: {Do} not fear what you are about to suffer Behold the devil is about to throw [some] of you into prison to test you and you will suffer tribulation [for] ten days Be faithful [even] unto death and I will give you the crown - of life

verses.original: Ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ Πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις Ὁ νικῶν οὐ μὴ ἀδικηθῇ ἐκ τοῦ τοῦ δευτέρου θανάτου
verses.transliteration: Ho echōn ous akousatō ti to Pneuma legei tais ekklēsiais HO nikōn ou mē adikēthē ek tou tou deuterou thanatou
verses.literal: He who has an ear let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches The [one who] overcomes vvv vvv will not be harmed by the - second death

verses.original: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἐν Περγάμῳ γράψον Τάδε λέγει ὁ ἔχων τὴν τὴν ὀξεῖαν τὴν δίστομον ῥομφαίαν
verses.transliteration: Kai tō angelō tēs ekklēsias en Pergamō grapson Tade legei ho echōn tēn tēn oxeian tēn distomon rhomphaian
verses.literal: - To the angel of the church in Pergamum write These [are] the words of the [One who] holds the - sharp - double-edged sword

verses.original: Οἶδα ποῦ κατοικεῖς ὅπου ὁ θρόνος τοῦ Σατανᾶ καὶ κρατεῖς μου τὸ ὄνομά καὶ οὐκ ἠρνήσω τὴν πίστιν μου καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις μου μου ὁ πιστός ὁ μάρτυς Ἀντιπᾶς ὃς ἀπεκτάνθη παρ’ ὑμῖν ὅπου ὁ Σατανᾶς κατοικεῖ
verses.transliteration: Oida pou katoikeis hopou ho thronos tou Satana kai krateis mou to onoma kai ouk ērnēsō tēn pistin mou kai en tais hēmerais mou mou ho pistos ho martys Antipas hos apektanthē par’ hymin hopou ho Satanas katoikei
verses.literal: I know where you live where the throne - of Satan [sits] yet you hold fast to My - name - vvv You did not deny [your] faith in Me even in the days of My - - faithful - witness Antipas who was killed among you where - Satan dwells

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ ἔχω ὀλίγα κατὰ σοῦ ὅτι ἐκεῖ ἔχεις κρατοῦντας τὴν διδαχὴν Βαλαάμ ὃς ἐδίδασκεν τῷ Βαλὰκ βαλεῖν σκάνδαλον ἐνώπιον τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ φαγεῖν εἰδωλόθυτα καὶ πορνεῦσαι
verses.transliteration: All’ echō oliga kata sou hoti ekei echeis kratountas tēn didachēn Balaam hos edidasken tō Balak balein skandalon enōpion tōn huiōn Israēl phagein eidōlothyta kai porneusai
verses.literal: But I have a few things against you because [some] of you hold to the teaching of Balaam who taught - Balak to place a stumbling block before the vvv Israelites so they would eat food sacrificed to idols and commit sexual immorality

verses.original: οὕτως ὁμοίως σὺ καὶ ἔχεις κρατοῦντας τὴν διδαχὴν τῶν Νικολαϊτῶν
verses.transliteration: houtōs homoiōs sy kai echeis kratountas tēn didachēn tōn Nikolaitōn
verses.literal: vvv In the same way [some of] you also - hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans

verses.original: οὖν μετανόησον δὲ εἰ μή ἔρχομαί σοι ταχύ καὶ πολεμήσω μετ’ αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ ῥομφαίᾳ μου τοῦ στόματός
verses.transliteration: oun metanoēson de ei mē erchomai soi tachy kai polemēsō met’ autōn en tē rhomphaia mou tou stomatos
verses.literal: Therefore repent Otherwise . . . . . . I will come to you shortly and wage war against them with the sword of My - mouth

verses.original: Ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ Πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις αὐτῷ Τῷ νικῶντι δώσω τοῦ τοῦ κεκρυμμένου μάννα καὶ δώσω αὐτῷ λευκήν ψῆφον γεγραμμένον ἐπὶ τὴν ψῆφον καὶ καινὸν ὄνομα ὃ οὐδεὶς οἶδεν εἰ μὴ ὁ λαμβάνων
verses.transliteration: Ho echōn ous akousatō ti to Pneuma legei tais ekklēsiais autō Tō nikōnti dōsō tou tou kekrymmenou manna kai dōsō autō leukēn psēphon gegrammenon epi tēn psēphon kai kainon onoma ho oudeis oiden ei mē ho lambanōn
verses.literal: He who has an ear let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches To [the one] who overcomes I will give - the hidden manna vvv I will also give him a white stone inscribed . . . . . . . . . [with] a new name - - known only . . . to the [one who] receives [it]

verses.original: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἐν Θυατείροις γράψον Τάδε λέγει ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ ὁ ἔχων αὐτοῦ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ὡς φλόγα πυρός καὶ αὐτοῦ οἱ πόδες ὅμοιοι χαλκολιβάνῳ
verses.transliteration: Kai tō angelō tēs ekklēsias en Thyateirois grapson Tade legei ho Huios tou Theou ho echōn autou tous ophthalmous hōs phloga pyros kai autou hoi podes homoioi chalkolibanō
verses.literal: - To [the] angel of the church in Thyatira write These [are] the words of the Son - of God - whose . . . - eyes [are] like a blazing fire and [whose] - feet [are] like polished bronze

verses.original: Οἶδά σου τὰ ἔργα καὶ σου τὴν ἀγάπην καὶ τὴν πίστιν καὶ τὴν διακονίαν καὶ τὴν ὑπομονήν καὶ σου τὰ ἔσχατα τὰ ἔργα πλείονα τῶν πρώτων
verses.transliteration: Oida sou ta erga kai sou tēn agapēn kai tēn pistin kai tēn diakonian kai tēn hypomonēn kai sou ta eschata ta erga pleiona tōn prōtōn
verses.literal: I know your - deeds - your - love - [your] faith - [your] service - [your] perseverance and your - latest - deeds [are] greater than [your] first

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ ἔχω κατὰ σοῦ ὅτι ἀφεῖς τὴν γυναῖκα Ἰεζάβελ ἡ λέγουσα ἑαυτὴν προφῆτιν καὶ διδάσκει καὶ πλανᾷ ἐμοὺς τοὺς δούλους πορνεῦσαι καὶ φαγεῖν εἰδωλόθυτα
verses.transliteration: Alla echō kata sou hoti apheis tēn gynaika Iezabel hē legousa heautēn prophētin kai didaskei kai plana emous tous doulous porneusai kai phagein eidōlothyta
verses.literal: But I have [this] against you - You tolerate that woman Jezebel who calls herself a prophetess - By her teaching - she misleads My - servants to be sexually immoral and to eat food sacrificed to idols

verses.original: καὶ ἔδωκα αὐτῇ χρόνον ἵνα μετανοήσῃ ἐκ αὐτῆς τῆς πορνείας καὶ οὐ θέλει μετανοῆσαι
verses.transliteration: kai edōka autē chronon hina metanoēsē ek autēs tēs porneias kai ou thelei metanoēsai
verses.literal: Even [though] I have given her time to repent of her - immorality - vvv she is unwilling -

verses.original: Ἰδοὺ βάλλω αὐτὴν εἰς κλίνην καὶ τοὺς μοιχεύοντας μετ’ αὐτῆς εἰς μεγάλην θλῖψιν ἐὰν μὴ μετανοήσωσιν ἐκ αὐτῆς τῶν ἔργων
verses.transliteration: Idou ballō autēn eis klinēn kai tous moicheuontas met’ autēs eis megalēn thlipsin ean mē metanoēsōsin ek autēs tōn ergōn
verses.literal: Behold I will cast her onto a bed of sickness and those who commit adultery with her [will suffer] great tribulation unless . . . they repent of her - deeds

verses.original: καὶ ἀποκτενῶ αὐτῆς τὰ τέκνα ἐν θανάτῳ καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ ἐκκλησίαι γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἐραυνῶν νεφροὺς καὶ καρδίας καὶ δώσω ἑκάστῳ ὑμῖν κατὰ ὑμῶν τὰ ἔργα
verses.transliteration: kai apoktenō autēs ta tekna en thanatō kai pasai hai ekklēsiai gnōsontai hoti egō eimi ho eraunōn nephrous kai kardias kai dōsō hekastō hymin kata hymōn ta erga
verses.literal: Then I will strike her - children - dead and all the churches will know that I am the [One who] searches minds and hearts and I will repay each of you according to your - deeds

verses.original: δὲ λέγω τοῖς λοιποῖς Ὑμῖν τοῖς ἐν Θυατείροις ὅσοι οὐκ ἔχουσιν ταύτην τὴν διδαχὴν οἵτινες οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὰ ὡς λέγουσιν βαθέα τοῦ Σατανᾶ βάλλω οὐ ἄλλο βάρος ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: de legō tois loipois Hymin tois en Thyateirois hosoi ouk echousin tautēn tēn didachēn hoitines ouk egnōsan ta hōs legousin bathea tou Satana ballō ou allo baros eph’ hymas
verses.literal: But I say to [the] rest of you - in Thyatira who {do} not hold to [her] - teaching [and] {have} not learned the vvv so-called deep things - of Satan I will place no further burden upon you

verses.original: πλὴν κρατήσατε ὃ ἔχετε ἄχρι οὗ ἂν ἥξω
verses.transliteration: plēn kratēsate ho echete achri hou an hēxō
verses.literal: than to hold fast to what you have until - - I come

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ νικῶν καὶ ὁ τηρῶν μου τὰ ἔργα ἄχρι τέλους δώσω αὐτῷ ἐξουσίαν ἐπὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai ho nikōn kai ho tērōn mou ta erga achri telous dōsō autō exousian epi tōn ethnōn
verses.literal: And to the [one who] overcomes and - continues {in} My - work until [the] end I will give - authority over the nations

verses.original: καὶ ποιμανεῖ αὐτοὺς ἐν σιδηρᾷ ῥάβδῳ συντρίβεται ὡς τὰ σκεύη τὰ κεραμικὰ ὡς κἀγὼ εἴληφα παρὰ τοῦ μου Πατρός
verses.transliteration: kai poimanei autous en sidēra rhabdō syntribetai hōs ta skeuē ta keramika hōs kagō eilēpha para tou mou Patros
verses.literal: - He will rule them with an iron scepter [and] shatter [them] like - vvv vvv pottery just as I have received [authority] from - My Father

verses.original: καὶ δώσω αὐτῷ τὸν τὸν πρωϊνόν ἀστέρα
verses.transliteration: kai dōsō autō ton ton prōinon astera
verses.literal: And I will give him the - morning star

verses.original: Ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ Πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις
verses.transliteration: Ho echōn ous akousatō ti to Pneuma legei tais ekklēsiais
verses.literal: He who has an ear let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches
